pairs.question: Cur igitur pacem nolo?
pairs.answer: Quia turpis est, quia periculosa, quia esse non potest.
pairs.derivation: Cicero poses the question and immediately answers it himself. The answer is the full tricolon (to the first full stop). What follows ('Quae tria dum explico, peto a vobis...') turns from answering to announcing how he will expound the three points, so the window ends at 'non potest.' The other interrogatives in the oration (e.g. 7.3 'Utrum igitur... an pertimescendi diligentior cautio est?', the strings of rhetorical questions in 7.21-25) receive no direct answer and were dropped.
